description: This file defines the Product model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, including methods for retrieving, updating, and managing product data such as prices, categories, images, discounts, and related products.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for handling product data operations in Opencart, including CRUD operations, related data retrieval, and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: editQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specified product in the database.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific product by its ID, including price, rating, reviews, and variants.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on provided filters such as category, search terms, manufacturer, and sorting options.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Returns the total count of products matching specified filters.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Fetches category data for a product within a specific category.

methods.name: getTotalCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Counts how many categories a product belongs to within a specific category.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Retrieves product code records linked to a product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Gets attribute groups and attributes for a product.

methods.name: editOptionQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific product option.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options associated with a product, including their values.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Gets data for a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOptionValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specific product option.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Fetches discount records applicable to a product.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves images associated with a product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Gets subscription plan details for a product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription plans linked to a product.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID assigned to a product.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves products related to a specific product.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Fetches products that are currently on special offer.

methods.name: getTotalSpecials
methods.description: Returns the total count of products on special offer.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new report entry for a product view or issue.
